senses.en_definition: Speech or talk; the words someone says.

collocations.en: do as one is told; heed advice

senses.en_definition: To speak or talk; to say or tell someone something; to speak a particular language.

messages.en: You free right now? I want to talk to you about that rental place.
I'm at work right now. Can we talk on the phone after six?
Could you let the boss know I'd like to take tomorrow off?
Sure, I'll let him know later. Have you submitted your leave form yet?

collocations.en: go on, say what you want to say

messages.en: Go on, tell me. I want to hear what happened earlier.
I accidentally sent a message to the boss earlier. So embarrassing.
Just add a tiny bit of milk to that coffee, okay?
Done. Want me to give it a stir too?
